sentences.en: Sami was found guilty of aggravated assault and attempted murder.
sentences.zh: 萨米因加重攻击罪和企图谋杀罪被判有罪。

sentences.en: The political crisis is aggravating the socio-economic crisis in Algeria.
sentences.zh: 政治危机正在加剧阿尔及利亚的社会经济危机。

sentences.en: The doctor's treatment has only aggravated my husband's condition.
sentences.zh: 医生的治疗反而使丈夫的情况更加恶化了。
